info.title: Android Binding Catalog Administration Contract
info.description: Specification only. No HTTP server, authentication provider or remote listener enabled. Catalog administration never grants Android invocation permission. Normative state, ETag and publication semantics: ../API-CONTRACT.md.

get.description: Bounded indexed search of effective catalog view. Inclusion of suppressed records requires admin scope. Stable ordering by entry_id within pinned view. include_suppressed=true includes suppressed, deleted and conflict states; default excludes all three. Any registry/overlay generation change expires the cursor with 410.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor pinned to registry and overlay view generation; never an offset

post.description: Create local overlay entry only. Server derives canonical ID. Imported ID collision returns 409; use PUT with current ETag to create an override.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Same key and same canonical request hash returns original result. Different hash returns 409.

ETag.description: Strong opaque revision token for this representation

422.description: Schema, source or semantic validation failed

get.description: Return effective entry plus ETag. Suppressed/deleted entries return 410; history remains available to admins. Current entry preconditions always use the cat1 ETag in API-CONTRACT.md.

put.description: Full validated Mutation replacement of local overlay only; canonical identity and imported evidence cannot change. Conflicts require x-resolution with current base hash; tombstones require current cat1 ETag and restore to active. Atomic history/revision append. See API-CONTRACT.md.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Semantically required. Missing returns 428 before generic validation; malformed/weak/list/wildcard returns 400; stale cat1 tag returns 412 with current tag. Obtain current tag from entry GET or history, including conflict/tombstone.

post.description: Stage hash-pinned artifact already present locally. No URL fetching or file-system path traversal. Validate hashes, source signatures, references, schema and full coverage report before eligible publication. Retry is idempotent; no active-view changes.

post.description: Atomically publish a validated immutable registry only. Compare expected_active_registry_id under BEGIN IMMEDIATE; mark overlay collisions/rebases/conflicts, retire old registry, switch active pointer, increment registry generation and append history/audit/outbox. Same principal/operation/idempotency-key+request replays original result. Failed transaction leaves all state unchanged. No registry If-Match is required because immutable registry ID, validated state and expected active pointer form the CAS precondition.

get.description: Read bounded current status/header and strong dv1 ETag, including generation-zero bootstrap with null header. Authorized exact profile/target only. stale forbids admission; availability is separate from permission.

200.description: Current snapshot plus stale/capability epoch; no remote facts accepted

ETag.description: Strong scope/generation/epoch/catalog/overlay token, including null-header bootstrap. Exact composition and canonical scope hashing in API-CONTRACT.md.

403.description: Profile/target access denied without existence disclosure

get.description: Immutable snapshot read for an authorized profile/target. Historical snapshot is not current authority; cursors pin view_id/generation and fail410 on invalidation.

post.description: Authenticated local owner only, within configured backend authority. Request bounded supported metadata refresh; never accept asserted facts, available flags, arbitrary probes or permission changes. Startup/event refresh uses the same internal coordinator. No HTTP service is implemented. After scope authorization, missing/malformed/mismatching strong current-status ETag returns428/400/412. Matched refresh atomically increments epoch and marks stale, including bootstrap; no duplicate stale token can be admitted. Exact dv1 syntax in API-CONTRACT.md.

202.description: Bounded internal refresh queued; epoch incremented and previous view stale

get.description: Bounded rows from one immutable snapshot. Full inventory retained. Cursor binds view/profile/target/authenticated reader/filter and expires410 on invalidation; availability never grants invocation.

200.description: Bounded page from the pinned view
